mapper.insert: insert into t_chat (from_id, to_id, content, create_time, is_read, msg_type, deleted_by_from, deleted_by_to) values (#{fromId}, #{toId}, #{content}, now(), #{isRead}, #{msgType}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: (SELECT * FROM t_chat WHERE from_id=#{userId} AND to_id=#{friendId}) UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM t_chat WHERE from_id=#{friendId} AND to_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT * FROM ( (SELECT * FROM t_chat WHERE from_id=#{userId} AND to_id=#{friendId} AND deleted_by_to = 0) UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM t_chat WHERE from_id=#{friendId} AND to_id=#{userId} AND deleted_by_from = 0) ) AS combined ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_chat WHERE (from_id = #{userId} AND to_id = #{friendId}) OR (from_id = #{friendId} AND to_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_complaint (complaint_user_id, target_user_id, session_id, reason, create_time) VALUES (#{complaintUserId}, #{targetUserId}, #{sessionId}, #{reason}, NOW())
